notes.title: The Beginning of Monument
notes.notes:
A few days ago I found something interesting, something from the beginning of Monument. It was a pack of early sketches. The pack contains some sketches of maps, weapons, monsters and etc.. Unfortunately, I couldn't find many of monster's sketches, but that's ok. At least, I glad to find something and I want to share it with you. And yeah, it has been almost 9 years since release.
I'd like to remind you that these sketches are from the first version of the game, it's not available now. But I think to upload this version for free a little later. Perhaps there will be those who want to see how it was.
Anyway, I hope you enjoy :)

notes.title: Awesome Big Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I have been preparing this update for a very long time and finally it happened. Almost all the fixes in the game were based on player feedback from the reviews, thank you for the bug reports. I hope everyone will like it!

[h3]Added new animations and alternative types of attacks to all enemies. Now the game has become more dynamic and more fun[/h3]

[b]Green candle[/b]
after death, they leave toxic smoke that damages the player

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hiFAYpB.gif[/img]

[b]Chickens[/b]
after death will spawn two of the same chickens, only small ones

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CqBl1gq.gif[/img]

[b]Hatcher[/b]
now have firespray attack mode. If you stand still, you can die quickly

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RzOccmt.gif[/img]

[b]Big chickens[/b]
large and dangerous fireballs can be thrown at a certain distance

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O1Itiy3.gif[/img]

[b]Aliens[/b]
now teleport around the player during combat. Now it is a very dangerous enemy, especially on the high level of difficulty.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TnddhE8.gif[/img]

[b]Added direction of attack indicator:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8963342/7f9b907de0ee218bda164faf9f69fff5cc30c08b.png[/img]

[b]The main boss now has health bar:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8963342/b1b2e23eb9f97ee2f74781a7b65f735cd35c97cb.png[/img]

- Low HP and ammo indicator

- Fixed achievements, now they appear during the game

- Fixed player sliding on the floor on slopes(Ice floor). There will be no more accidental deaths

- Added walking sounds for all monsters

- Fixed the autosave system. Now there will be no situations when autosave is triggered when monsters are alive

- I saved your ears! :D Now, on first launch, sound and music are not set to full volume 

- Fixed attack through the projectile

- Significantly reduced level loading time

- Reworked the difficulty of the game. Now it affects not only enemy HP and attack

- And many many other fixes...

[h3]And finally a new map has been added! It's called "Toxic Cave". The new map also contains 4 difficult secrets! :D[/h3]

Map positions:
1 - Entrance to hell
2 - Blood hollow
3 - Obelisk room
4 - Chasm
[b]5 - Toxic cave[/b]
6 - Arena of pain

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hpwDyF2.gif[/img]

Because a lot of things have been changed, in this version your save will be deleted, sorry.

[b]
GL & HF[/b]

notes.title: Monument Update 06.02.20
notes.notes:
- Added check-points!
- Added  Quick-save button (F5 by default)
- Added VSYNC option to graphics menu
- Fixed saving the selected weapon between maps and when loading
- Added chapters added to "New Game" (chapters open as you progress)
- Added statistics of level in HUD (Secrets, Monsters)
- Crosshair effect when hit by an enemy
- Added cheat-mode !
        Press F1 to enable "cheat-mode"
          1) "POKOLENO" - Immortal
          2) "FPSCOUNT" - Enable fps counter
          3) "RAMBOMOD" - Enable all weapons, full ammo, full health and armor
          4) "NEXTLEVL" - Go to the next level
- Fixed mouse inversion settings
- Fixed two machinegun in keyboard menu
- Fixed missing monsters
- Main menu fixes
- Fixed some monsters balance
- Fixed death with immortality in the lava

[b]GL & HF[/b]

notes.title: Global game update
notes.notes:
This happened! The game is completely rewritten from scratch. Meet a brand new game with Improve game performance. What's new:

[b]- The game is completely rewritten from scratch[/b]
[b]- Improve game performance[/b]
[b]- Gameplay has become faster[/b]

[b]- TELEPORT GUN[/b]
You can teleport anywhere on the map, just shoot at the right place

[b]- NEW MAPS[/b]
All maps made from scratch

[b]- STRAFE JUMP[/b]
like a defrag mode in quake

[b]- NEW WEAPONS[/b]
All weapons made from scratch

[b]- DONAR STATION[/b]
You can get ammunition for your health

I hope you will like it. Have a nice game. GL & HF !
